prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1238; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. Complaints centered on neck and low back pain with associated muscle guarding and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent in type and magnitude with the force of the impact described. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury or treatment to the same body areas is known to this provider. Care was delivered over 13 visits, consisting of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. The course of treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this severity, reflecting a gradual but steady response. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing observed. Patient was discharged with a home exercise program and advised to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
